props.headline: A cautious, climate-aligned portfolio of 7 companies
props.narrative: We screened 11 companies against your sector rules and causes, kept 7, and weighted them for a low-risk profile.
Your risk level of 2 favours stable, income-producing holdings.
Three companies were excluded by your rules; one more failed our ethical review on fair wages.
Minerva Mining was accepted despite high emissions because of its credible reduction plan.
Our largest position: stable cash flow and a fully renewable generation mix.
Defence exposure and commodity price risk are worth a second look.
